description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Obstinate Gargoyle.
When Obstinate Gargoyle dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Obstinate Gargoyle.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
